parameters.name: md

set protocols cfm ma ma1.explanation: Configure the maintenance association of CFM.

parameters.name: ma
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the association.

set protocols cfm mep 1.explanation: This command configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) in the Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) protocol, specifying parameters like domain, association, and direction for fault detection.

interface ge-0/0/1.1.explanation: Configure the interface for CFM MEP.

direction outward.explanation: Configures the maintenance endpoint (Maintenance End Point) of the CFM and its direction.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.explanation: Maintains the direction of the endpoint, outward.

set protocols cfm mep 3.explanation: This command configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) in the Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) protocol, specifying parameters like domain, association, and direction for fault detection.

ccm-send enable.explanation: Enables the CCM (Continuity Check Message) send that specifies the maintenance endpoint.

parameters.name: ccm-send
parameters.explanation: Enables or disables CCM sending functions.

ccm-receive enable.explanation: Enables the CCM reception function that specifies the remote maintenance endpoint.

parameters.name: ccm-receive
parameters.explanation: Enables or disables the reception of CCM.

set protocols cfm test-id 2.explanation: This command sets up a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) test instance with a specified `test-id` for monitoring and troubleshooting Ethernet OAM (Operations, Administration, and Maintenance).

mep 3.explanation: This command configures a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) test by specifying a test ID and associating it with a Maintenance End Point (MEP) for fault detection.

remote-mep 4.explanation: Configure CFM test ID, connect local and remote maintenance endpoints.

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: Remotely maintains the ID of the endpoint.

set protocols cfm loss-measure dual-ende.explanation: This command configures Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) loss measurement with specified parameters to monitor packet loss between network devices.

parameters.name: loss-measure
parameters.explanation: Dropped measurement type, dual-ended indicates double-end measurements.

test-id 2.explanation: Configures the double end of the CFM to continuously drop the package measurement.

set routing-instances evpna.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: bridge-domain

routing-instance evpna.explanation: Links the bridge domain to the specified route example.

parameters.name: routing-instance
